name: pass-strength-hover-indicator
title: Password Strength Hover
blurb: Password input with dot strength indicator and requirements in a hover tooltip.
description: A password form with 5 dots showing strength and an info icon that triggers a hover card displaying the requirements checklist with check/cross icons.
use_when: Building password forms where visual dot strength feedback is needed but space for the checklist is limited.
avoid_when: When all requirements must always be visible or when hover interactions should be avoided.
a11y: Password input is properly labeled, info icon triggers hover card, requirements list has aria-label.
